Our House

We grew up in a brewery, joined forces as siblings to open a gin distillery, and now we’ve opened our first wine and cocktail bar.

A fresh cocktail list each month, sparkling wines by the glass to pair with our artisan charcuterie boards, and wine and spirits tastings to develop your palate.

Our story started in 2014, when as fresh-faced teens we opened Sibling Distillery from a disused office in our parents’ micro-brewery. We smashed through the ceiling to fit a ‘prototype still’ and began making spirits one bottle at a time. Literally.

In 2020, lockdown gave us spare time for the first time since launch, so we started studying wine. In 2021 the chance to open a bar came back to us, and this time we took no persuading.

And with that, we’d love to invite you to Our House.
